[tunzafun001] @Clear
This is a first for me.
I bought an adjustable TV stand $80. Arrived bent in half (must have been significant, it's solid 30kg).
Anyway, reached out to support. They wanted me to post it back. But normally they provide the shipping lable, this time it was my responsibility? Then they will refund it (allegedly). Had x number of days to do so.
Aussie post wouldn't do it, as it is too big (box is too big and way over acceptable weight).
Best aggregater Courier quote was $152..Most around $200.. So I reached out and asked them if I should just bin it, as return post is 2x value.
They said they will escalate to senior and get back to me.
The return timer kept ticking. Now expired. So I went back to ask. They are saying you didn't return it in time ??
So about to file a chargeback with CBA. Screenshots of all their messages and freight quote.
Should I have done something different? Ie. Paid the $152 ??
Figured the best i would get is my $80 back???
[Clear] I think a chargeback is probably your only option in this case.
